notes.title: THIS IS MORTAL SHELL II
notes.content:
[p]We’re working on [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584270/Mortal_Shell_II/"]Mortal Shell II[/url].[/b] [/p][p]
It feels incredible to finally say that without whispering. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/b40d2d116e53025d2fbf2185ee26cbbb6303160a.gif"][/img]

Here’s the world premiere trailer which aired today at Summer Game Fest: 
[/p][previewyoutube="w0SLSLuYMhw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel, set to launch worldwide in 2026 on PlayStation 5, Steam and Xbox.[/p][p]
Today we are opening sign-ups to the game’s Beta, which is scheduled to begin in early 2026. [/p][p]
Visit [url="https://mortalshell.com"]mortalshell.com[/url] to register for the Beta. [/p][p]
[i](If you’ve already signed up to the Mortal Shell newsletter, you’re going to be auto-enrolled for the Mortal Shell II Beta - you should receive an email about this).[/i]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/cd6a6ece3dca1ed5ddd55e9ed84efd3dd5f22c83.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Mortal Shell II is the result of our obsession with dark fantasy, action RPGs, and high-stakes combat. It is a vision shaped by everything we love about these genres, distilled into a single, relentless experience.[/p][p]
With Mortal Shell II, we are building a deeply atmospheric open world, expansive yet deliberately compact, designed to unfold its twisted landscapes and hidden structures at a measured pace.

Your journey will be marked by brutal, high-intensity combat, both melee and ranged, against relentless enemies that demand your full attention and mastery.[/p][p]
You won’t need to have played the first Mortal Shell to dive into the sequel. However, returning players will find echoes of familiar faces, some changed, some forgotten, alongside entirely new Shells to discover and inhabit.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/bfa6cf60e3f0920de73e257a86e934b89e4d9c17.gif"][/img][/p][p]
There is much more we will reveal as we move closer to release. 

For now, we hope you enjoy the trailer.[/p][p]
Thank you.[/p][p][b]
- Cold Symmetry[/b][/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: New to Fallgrim? Welcome, Foundling!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Mortal Shell's world can be unforgiving, if you're new to the game here are some top tips to get you started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/2d234e8864fa322adb62923a31d049349901cee5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Top tips from the Mortal Shell Team[/h3]

[b]FINDING THE TARNISHED SEAL[/b]
Firstly, here's a [url=https://www.ign.com/wikis/mortal-shell/What_to_Do_First_in_Mortal_Shell]great guide from IGN[/url] for getting started and where to go first. Don’t forget to pick up the [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Tarnished+Seal]Tarnished Seal[/url] from the Old Prisoner, you’re gonna need it! If you accidentally leave Fallgrim without grabbing the Tarnished Seal, you won't be able to parry or use your heal infusion. As you enter Fallgrim for the first time, you'll see a tower across the pond. Head here to find the Old Prisoner, and although he has "little to offer," he'll grant you the Tarnished Seal which you'll be using a lot.

[b]GET TO KNOW YOUR SHELL[/b]
Everyone has their preferred playstyle when it comes to soulslikes. In Mortal Shell, there are four inhabitable slain warriors, known as ‘shells’ with unique attributes in durability, stamina, and resolve. All shells can be found around Fallgrim, with some branching out near the entrances of the temples. If you try them all as you find them, you can get a feel for the shell(s) that suit your playstyle. Want to be light and quick? Tiel. Want to be a tank with stacks of health? Eredrim. And so forth. To change shells, you can head back to Fallgrim Tower (the Old Prisoner's home) and inhabit discovered shells on the ground level.

For an overview of all the inhabitable shells in the game, here's a [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Shells]useful article on Fextralife[/url].

[b]STRIKE AT THE RIGHT MOMENT[/b]
Combat is strategic, deliberate, and unforgiving. Take your time and don’t feel like you have to rush into a fight. As you progress through and encounter each type of foe, it’ll become easier to gauge the types of attacks enemies are about to unfurl against you, and when they’ll pause for an opening. Keep an eye on both your stamina bar and [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Hardening]harden[/url] cooldown during combat, as these two are big factors when deciding whether to harden or dodge.  There will be different times when it’s best to harden-attack or completely dodge an incoming flurry. Don’t forget, you can combine light attacks and heavy attacks with any weapon for a deadly mix. 

Here’s an advanced combat guide from [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUEBwthcpWBTQXscn8bpS6Q]Boomstick Gaming[/url]:
[previewyoutube=grSzc5Tm9Zo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]EMPOWERED RIPOSTES[/b]
The Old Prisoner has infused your Tarnished Seal with useful ripostes. Each [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Tarnished+Seal+Abilities]empowered riposte[/url] uses up a resolve bar, but the highly skilled can perform a riposte with an empty bar to gain resolve. Beware that your Tarnished Seal will alert you by glowing and making a sound when an unparryable attack is incoming - dodge or harden against these! Getting the timing right takes some practice, so don’t let it get you down if you miss them all at first! For some, it may be a good idea to learn your favorite enemy attacks to parry, and save your riposte for those guaranteed heals using the [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Seal+Infusion+-+Healing]healing infusion[/url].

[b]ITEMS, ITEMS, ITEMS[/b]
Throughout your journey, you’ll find useful [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Items]items[/url] laying about, from glimpses to tar, to mushrooms. The game is built on using items to find out what they do, so every time you pick up an item, it’s a good idea to try it out - you’ll never know if you don’t try! Each time you use an item, your [i]familiarity [/i] with that item will increase, which will improve the item's benefit as you become more familiar with it. Explorers are rewarded with lucrative items, especially when opening Frog Chests in [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/The+Mist]the Mist[/url] after collecting a sacred gland. When you find weapon upgrades or tools, be sure to check them out using the workbench found at Fallgrim Tower and near the entrances to all three temples.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/d227149ba23cbda5bbfeddda0875b6c8804d03ee.png[/img]

[b]HARDEN YOURSELF[/b]
There are no shields in Mortal Shell, only your hardened shell - your most important defense. As a rule of thumb, it’s efficient to harden while [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Combat]attacking[/url]. This means that less time is used winding up your attack, with the added bonus of stunning the enemy and opening up for a follow-up hit or two.

[b]RECLAIM YOUR LOST SHELLS[/b]
When your health drops down to zero, you get two chances; one where you get knocked out of your shell with the ability to re-inhabit it, and one where you die, lose all your glimpses and tar, and re-awaken at the [url=https://mortalshell.wiki.fextralife.com/Sester+Genessa]sester[/url]. As you reawaken, your old shell, glimpses, and tar you were carrying aren’t actually lost - it’s right where you left it! All you have to do to reclaim it is find out where you died and interact with it. Kind of like retrieving lost souls, right? As well as retrieving your lost belongings, another bonus is that your health bar is refilled. This can come in very useful when fighting tough bosses, as you can retrieve your old fallen shell for a free health boost during a battle.

[url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/8755b708a64f39c0a8f3e3a01cc4113d4c457d54.png[/img][/url]

[b]ASK THE COMMUNITY[/b]
Mortal Shell can be an unforgiving game, both to veterans and new players of the genre. When hopping over from Dark Souls, Nioh, etc., the unfamiliar feel can be frustrating! We’ve definitely all been there, hoping that one day we can [i]git gud[/i]. There’s a knowledgeable and dedicated community just a few clicks away if you ever need to look for help. Just head over to the [url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell]Discord server[/url], where you can chat about your experiences, ask for help, and share your glorious in-game media.

Of course, there’s a lot more to learn about the world but hopefully, this guide will help you on your quest to seek ascension.

Take care,
[i]- Team Mortal Shell[/i]

notes.title: Photo Mode Competition Winners!
notes.content:
On The Virtuous Cycle's launch, we invited everybody to take part in a community photo mode competition on the [url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell]Mortal Shell Discord server[/url].

Once again, the response was phenomenal! With around 1700 entries from 200 entrants in total, we were blown away by so many incredible photos - it brought us joy to judge them all and see the great works of many virtual photographers. A big thank you to everyone who participated and helped make it a success. 

Here are your winners - each will be receiving a very special Mortal Shell + HyperX prize bundle right on their doorsteps!  Congratulations to all, and once again, a big thank you to everyone who took part.

[b]💥 AMinPhoto - Action Shot[/b]
"The combined dark and light tones on either side of the shot make for an astoundingly dramatic action shot between Imrod and Hadern here. The glow emanating from Imrod's mace is a great way to show his awesome power."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/f3a0f3131600434f985c50f823041348094cf9a6.jpg[/img]

[b]🎨 mt13 - Artistic Vision[/b]
"A simple yet provoking composition of Hadern facing upwards toward Fallgrim Tower, seemingly open to the viewer's interpretation. Perfect."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/f4d687d73093feab4f0bfebe47edbe62881d1e36.jpg[/img]

[b]😜 h00tio - Funny/Odd Moment[/b]
"A situation that has likely caught a few players feeling both tormented and chuckling. Beautifully tragic."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/4e8f059a769257b5ebb4a04c75cfa253e5f3cd69.jpg[/img]

[b]🏆 Zolberg99 - Random Winner[/b]
"Sweet low angle shot of Sester Genessa, the composition goes well with the figure on the right side. Incredible atmosphere."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/c1648ad6975ccc69a737dcca935a579027bab698.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone for all the glorious entries! See all the incredible pictures sent to us on our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/mortalshell

[h2]Mortal Shell has joined the United Servers of Discord Alliance![/h2]

The [url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell]Mortal Shell Discord[/url] has joined the United Servers of Discord Alliance! This is a group of collaborating servers ranging from the League of Legends Discord to the Terraria Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/26b2096da8e6dbf6502dbe4213be83cf13c2dd9b.png[/img][/url]

The Alliance provides our Discord members with some really great features such as cross-Discord chat in the #alliance-chat channel, this means that Mortal Shell Discorders can chat with hundreds of thousands of other users from different communities.

There is also a fun Alliance Trivia game, which runs every 8 hours and puts the Mortal Shell Discord up against another random Alliance member to battle over their trivia knowledge! You can find this in the  #alliance-trivia channel on our server.

We think this is a great addition to our already awesome community and look forward to more exciting events in the future. 

See you on Discord!

[i]-Team Mortal Shell[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.014707
notes.content:
Thanks to you, our dedicated community, we've been able to identify and implement fixes for frequently reported issues since the release of The Virtuous Cycle. Please find the latest list of changes below.

[h2]Update Notes for Build 08.25.21 Revision 1.014707[/h2]
[list]
[*] Twin-Sister's dialogues when acquiring a new Instinct can now be skipped with the mouse
[*] Fixed an audio-related bug that was causing crashes on PC
[*] The user can now progress from the Seed Window at the end of a cycle with the mouse by clicking the "Continue" button
[*] Axatana Weapon Abilities should no longer get interrupted by the shield bash from Gragu or kick attacks from vampires
[*] Solomon's Accretion of Inheritance ability should now work correctly when equipped by Hadern
[*] Fixed the "hidden mouse cursor" bug that affected the "New Instinct Acquired" window
[*] The user can no longer gain resolve from Axatana Weapon Abilities
[/list]
[h2]Update Notes for Previous Build 08.20.21 Revision 1.014622[/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue with the Axe Super glitching when landing on top of an enemy has been fixed
[*] Issue with the Dual Katanas Super getting interrupted has been fixed
[*] Issue with the Dark Shell Boss Fight hard-locking after dealing the final blow has been fixed
[*] Issue that blocks trading with Hadern when reaching NG+ has been fixed
[*] Resolve Cost for the Axatana Weapon Ability is now correctly reduced when Hadern's ability is active
[*] Change to make how to access The Virtuous Cycle clearer
[*] Additions to the End Credits
[*] Other small bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
[h2]Bug Reporting[/h2]
Bugs can be reported [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1110910/discussions/1/]here on our Steam Discussions[/url].

When reporting a bug, please have the following information to hand:
[list]
[*] What was the issue?
[*] What game version is displayed in the bottom left of the main menu?
[*] What did you do to have it happen?
[*] Does it happen if you try to reproduce it using the same steps you listed on the previous question?
[*] Which shell, weapon, and item were in use?
[*] Were either Rotting Christ or The Virtuous Cycle content enabled?
[*] What are your system specs?
[/list]
If you have video or images you wish to share illustrating your bug, please consider using our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdNYZOQEdGeDw9pEgjYtilCVz3ZymaJDFB8A0QPPsCKH3j0IA/viewform]bug reports form[/url].

We are continuing to use information shared through bug reports to work on further improvements to the stability and performance of the game.

notes.title: Mortal Shell's Release Date! (+ Details on The Virtuous Cycle!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We get asked all kinds of questions from our fans, but the most common one by far is "Steam When". Today we are delighted to say we finally have the answer for you: 

[h2]Mortal Shell and The Virtuous Cycle: Coming to Steam August 18[/h2]

And to mark the occasion, we have just revealed a world-first gameplay trailer of The Virtuous Cycle, our roguelike expansion. Take a look:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q8HZ70J8eXU

[h3]Here’s a rundown of The Virtuous Cycle’s new features:[/h3]

[h3]New Mode[/h3]
Carve through an ever-changing world where no two playthroughs are the same. Craft your own combat style by combining more than 100 unique upgrades.

[h3]New Shell[/h3]
Possess a familiar and formidable foe, Hadern. Unearth his true potential and demand perfection from this once-elusive Shell.

[h3]New Weapon[/h3]
Fallgrim’s most venerable weapon has been cast. Transform your combat with the Axatana, a manipulable hilt of two blades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37287879/fe23c269baa27143b47d1249f3111e14a30f0770.gif[/img]

And of course, new lore that sheds light on Fallgrim’s mysterious past.

Catch us on [url=https://twitter.com/MortalShellGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/MortalShellGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/mortalshellgame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/mortalshell]Discord[/url] for all the latest news and content.

We can’t wait for your journey to begin.

-Team Mortal Shell
